evals.prompt: We are verifying a database migration when upgrading from v1.0 to v2.0. Is setting appium:noReset: true sufficient to prove the upgrade?
evals.expected_output: No: noReset only preserves the current container/session state; it does not simulate installing an upgrade build binary over a prior build (AC-26). Binary upgrade testing requires installing the prior build, seeding data, and installing the candidate binary over it without full reset.
